name: Trend Micro Vision One
description: Connect your own Trend Micro Vision One XDR tenant to manage Workbench alerts, Endpoint Security (isolate/restore, scan), Suspicious Object Lists (IOCs), Observed Attack Techniques, and XDR data lake Search queries.

tools.name: connect_trend_micro
tools.description: Connect your own Trend Micro Vision One tenant (data-center region + Authentication Token), verifying the credentials with a real call before saving.

label.description: Optional friendly name for this connection.
label.title: Label

region.description: Data center region: us, eu, in, au, sg, or jp.
region.title: Region

api_token.description: Authentication Token from Administration > API Keys.
api_token.title: Api Token

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected Trend Micro Vision One tenants.

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: disconnect_trend_micro
tools.description: Disconnect a Trend Micro Vision One tenant: deletes the saved Authentication Token. Nothing in Vision One itself is changed.

tools.name: list_workbench_alerts
tools.description: List Trend Micro Vision One Workbench alerts on the connected tenant, optionally filtered by status.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_workbench_alert
tools.description: Read one Trend Micro Vision One Workbench alert in full.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: update_workbench_alert
tools.description: Update a Trend Micro Vision One Workbench alert's status and/or investigation result.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

investigation_result.description: Investigation result note, required when closing as True/False Positive.
investigation_result.title: Investigation Result

tools.name: list_endpoints
tools.description: List endpoints enrolled in the connected Trend Micro Vision One tenant.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: isolate_endpoint
tools.description: Isolate a Trend Micro Vision One endpoint from the network. The endpoint stays protected but loses almost all network access -- confirm the target host before running.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

endpoint_name.description: Endpoint hostname or IP to isolate from the network. This blocks nearly all network access -- confirm the target first.
endpoint_name.title: Endpoint Name

description.description: Optional reason recorded with this action.
description.title: Description

tools.name: restore_endpoint
tools.description: Restore network connection for a previously isolated Trend Micro Vision One endpoint.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

endpoint_name.description: Endpoint hostname or IP to restore network connectivity to.
endpoint_name.title: Endpoint Name

description.description: Optional reason recorded with this action.
description.title: Description

tools.name: scan_endpoint
tools.description: Trigger an on-demand malware scan on a Trend Micro Vision One endpoint.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

endpoint_name.description: Endpoint hostname or IP to trigger an on-demand scan on.
endpoint_name.title: Endpoint Name

description.description: Optional reason recorded with this action.
description.title: Description

tools.name: list_suspicious_objects
tools.description: List Suspicious Objects (fleet-wide indicators) configured on the connected Trend Micro Vision One tenant.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

obj_type.description: Filter by type: file_sha1, file_sha256, ip, domain, url. Empty = all.
obj_type.title: Obj Type

tools.name: create_suspicious_object
tools.description: Add a Suspicious Object (hash, IP, domain, or URL) to the connected Trend Micro Vision One tenant. scan_action defaults to 'log' (monitor only) -- pass 'block' explicitly to actively deny it fleet-wide.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

value.description: The indicator value, e.g. a SHA-256 hash, IP, domain, or URL.
value.title: Value

obj_type.description: Indicator type: file_sha1, file_sha256, ip, domain, or url.
obj_type.title: Obj Type

scan_action.description: 'log' (monitor only, default) or 'block' (actively deny fleet-wide). Defaults to 'log' so an indicator is never silently blocked -- see app.py docstring.
scan_action.title: Scan Action

description.description: Optional reason/context recorded with this indicator.
description.title: Description

tools.name: remove_suspicious_object
tools.description: Permanently remove a Suspicious Object from the connected Trend Micro Vision One tenant. Cannot be undone.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

obj_type.description: Indicator type of the value being removed.
obj_type.title: Obj Type

tools.name: list_attack_techniques
tools.description: List ATT&CK-mapped Observed Attack Techniques detected on the connected Trend Micro Vision One tenant.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: run_search_query
tools.description: Run a Search query (Vision One's XDR data lake query engine) against the connected tenant's telemetry within a bounded time window.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

query.description: Vision One Search query, e.g. "eventSubId:101 AND objectFilePath:*.exe".
query.title: Query

start_time.description: ISO 8601 start of the search window. Empty = last 24h.
start_time.title: Start Time

end_time.description: ISO 8601 end of the search window. Empty = now.
end_time.title: End Time

tools.name: audit_trend_micro_tenant
tools.description: Build one aggregated health report across the connected Trend Micro Vision One tenant: open Workbench alerts by severity, isolated endpoints, and active-block Suspicious Objects.

connection_id.description: Connection id; omit to use the only connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id
